the behavior of protein molecules during their transport from the solution to the gas phase inside the ES droplets.

the protein conformation inside the charged ES core, which is a very important issue in the ES-MS of protein and protein complexes.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the conformational stability of the protein molecules is not only dependent on the solvent environment but also the timescale of the phase transition.
the ES process is not only a physical phenomenon but also a chemical process.

the conformational changes of the protein molecules inside the charged ES core droplet can be induced by the solvent perturbation and that is reflected as the multimodal charge states in the corresponding mass spectrum.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the protein conformation inside the ES droplets can be controlled by changing the composition of the droplet solvent.

the protein conformation inside the charged ES drop can be manipulated by changing the solvent environment of the ES droplets and the extent of the protein conformation change is dependent on its structural flexibility.

the protein conformation can be altered inside the neutral core (aqueous phase) of the charged ES droplets, and this is a result of the perturbation of solvent environment inside the charged ES micro-droplets.
